adopted_scope: Three original-source relation regression tests only. No coordinate/layout algorithm candidate adopted.
fixture_literals: Page IDs and source Word IDs are static regression oracle addresses, not production branches.
new_contracts: Original name fragments remain in their printed column and source order.
Before/after cells remain in the same original printed row, represented either by a plain row or by a structured table row.
A related balance sheet remains with its parent publication and outside an independent publication.
not_proven: Existing parser rules are all general; old fixed-distance/length/line-count conditions remain under audit.
Native font-metric rectangles prove visible ink or universal publication ownership.
Preserving words, coordinates, character multisets or passing lib tests proves correct reading order or parent/child association.
The unmodified bank or signatureless fundraising notice is fully repaired.
Any prototype is ready for adoption merely because its selected tests pass.
remaining_legacy_example: financial_enclosures.rs still has title/name length restrictions, minimum support counts and fixed-point containment/band conditions; this batch does not remove or endorse them.
